create sequence "public"."docs_n_seq" as bigint start 1 increment 1;

-- class: expand

create table "public"."docs" (
  "id" bigint not null,
  "n" bigint not null default nextval('docs_n_seq'::regclass),
  constraint "docs_pkey" primary key ("id")
);

-- class: expand
-- kind: alter-sequence

alter sequence "public"."docs_n_seq" owned by "public"."docs"."n";
